market.schedule: every 5 minutes at UTC minute divisible by 5
market.settlement_price_source: Chainlink BTC/USD TWAP 60s stream named by Gamma resolutionSource
market.missing_official_outcome_policy: exclude from official-label metrics; retain price-proxy row when complete
market.missing_window_candle_policy: target missing unless all five 1m target-window candles exist

features.source: Binance COIN-M BTCUSD index 1m OHLCV plus causal derived features
features.candle_values_available_at: candle close, nominally Opened + 1 minute; actual receive time must be measured live
features.actual_prediction_available_at: measured per prediction by collector; null in historical batch data
features.actual_execution_available_at: measured per quote/order observation by collector; null in historical batch data
features.decision_market_start_alignment: Opened + 2 minutes; UTC Opened minute modulo 5 equals 3

chronological_split_frozen_before_tuning.internal_validation_label_purge: keep training rows only when target_label_available_at <= first validation nominal_decision_at
chronological_split_frozen_before_tuning.test_history_status: historically exposed: this exact official-market period and overlapping BTC observations were used in prior repository experiments; new fitted artifacts must not use it, but this is not a pristine holdout

evaluation.primary_rows: actual Polymarket decision timestamps only (Opened minute modulo 5 equals 3)

paired_uncertainty.method: moving calendar-block bootstrap paired on identical market rows

reproduction.resume: python run_btc_preopen_experiment.py resumes the matching manifest/checkpoints
